mapper.select: select * from timeslot where scenic_id = #{scenicId} order by start_time asc
select * from timeslot where scenic_id = #{scenicId} and status = 1 order by start_time asc
mapper.insert: insert into timeslot(scenic_id, name, start_time, end_time, status) values(#{scenicId}, #{name}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{status})
mapper.update: update timeslot set name=#{name}, start_time=#{startTime}, end_time=#{endTime}, updated_at=now() where id=#{id}
update timeslot set status=#{status}, updated_at=now() where id=#{id}
